name: OpenAI
description: GPT models, ChatGPT, the OpenAI API, Codex, Sora, partnerships, leadership and policy.

items.title: OpenAI spotlights Legora’s legal-work AI platform and use of OpenAI products
items.summary: OpenAI profiled Legora’s legal AI platform, which uses OpenAI models for workflows including agentic legal work and document review. The article also notes Legora’s use of ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots, illustrating the company’s products across both customer-facing software and internal operations.

items.title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI and Oracle are expanding their partnership to bring Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and to develop new Oracle products and services powered by OpenAI. U.S. Oracle customers will also be able to purchase the OpenAI API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work through Oracle Marketplace, broadening the partnership’s enterprise and developer reach.

items.title: OpenAI and Fanatics launch AI-powered Shop the Look
items.summary: Fanatics launched Shop the Look, an OpenAI-powered feature that recommends coordinated, in-stock merchandise to sports fans. OpenAI says its team and Fanatics used Codex to develop recommendation tools, and testing across roughly 30,000 MLB products produced 10% higher engagement than the previous experience.

items.title: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner on AI safety and security
items.summary: OpenAI announced a partnership with Poland’s NASK focused on AI safety, security, and technical research. The collaboration is intended to strengthen safeguards and support a more resilient digital ecosystem; it was published before the monitoring start date.
